name: Foundernees
one_liner: A movement that walks people who have never built anything — starting in Pakistan — from first prototype to founder, using AI as the lever.
notes: Two builds in sequence: (1) marketing site — mission + signup capture, (2) the platform — Stage One/Two learning and building. Domain foundernees.com is registered on Cloudflare (created 2026-07-07), currently parked with no A record. Year One clock: 14 Aug 2026 -> 14 Aug 2027.
